# Copilot Instructions for Raki Distributor Website

## Project Overview
This is a **static website** for Distribuidora Raki Ltda., a wholesale distributor of artisanal products from southern Chile. The site serves as a digital product catalog targeting B2B customers with a rustic, artisanal aesthetic.

## Architecture

### Stack & Structure
- **Pure vanilla JavaScript** - No frameworks, no build process, no bundlers
- **Single-page application** with modal overlays for products and contact
- Directly deployed to GitHub Pages via `.github/workflows/pages.yml`
- Spanish language throughout (all content, comments, and user-facing text)

### Key Files
- `index.html` - Main HTML with embedded critical CSS (lines 69-549) for performance
- `styles.css` - Additional styles (imported at line 66)
- `script.js` - All interactivity: carousel, modals, contact form, analytics
- `assets/` - Product images (WebP format), logos, and carousel slides

## Development Patterns

### Styling Conventions
- **Font stack**: 'Playfair Display' (headings), 'Lora' (body) - artisanal serif aesthetic
- **Color palette**: 
  - Primary: `#2c6f4b` (forest green)
  - Accent: `#ff7a59` (coral/orange)
  - Background: `#f8f4ef` (warm cream)
  - Text: `#3e2f1c` (dark brown)
- **Responsive breakpoints**: 480px, 640px, 768px, 1024px
- **Animation**: Intersection Observer for card fade-in (see `script.js` lines 11-22)

### JavaScript Architecture
- **Event-driven**: All interactions set up in single `DOMContentLoaded` listener (line 9)
- **Modal system**: Shared overlay pattern for product details and carousel modal
- **Carousel**: Touch-enabled with auto-play (5s interval), custom implementation (lines 319-417)
- **Contact form**: EmailJS integration (service_ggzbnsk, template_7xaxazk) with fallback to `mailto:`

### Analytics Integration
- **Dual tracking**: Google Tag Manager (GTM-T7MQ65QT) + Google Analytics 4 (G-V14QD642ED)
- **Custom events**: Use `trackEvent()` function (defined in `index.html` lines 31-38)
- Track: product clicks, carousel navigation, form submissions, social media clicks
- Example: `trackEvent('product_click', 'lacteos', 'queso_chanco', 3800)`

## Critical Workflows

### Adding Products
1. Add product card in appropriate `<section>` (lacteos, carnicos, gourmet, salsas)
2. Follow this structure:
```html
<article class="card" onclick="trackEvent('product_click', 'category', 'product_name', price)">
  <img src="./assets/image.webp" alt="Product name" loading="lazy" />
  <div class="card-content">
    <h3>Product Name</h3>
    <p>Description text.</p>
    <p class="price">Por mayor: $X.XXX</p>
  </div>
</article>
```
3. Product images are auto-wired to modals via event delegation (see `script.js` lines 94-120)

### Modifying Carousel
- Slides are in `.carousel-track` (lines 571-582)
- Update slide count in indicators section (lines 584-588)
- Indicator buttons are auto-generated by script (lines 334-343)
- To change auto-play interval: modify line 383 (currently 5000ms)

### Contact Form Configuration
- EmailJS credentials in `script.js` lines 6-7
- Form submission handler: lines 209-313
- Success feedback closes form after 2s (line 282)
- Fallback `mailto:` if EmailJS fails (lines 288-306)

## Important Conventions

### Accessibility
- **ARIA attributes**: All interactive elements have proper labels
- `aria-hidden` and `inert` used for collapsed sections (contact form, modals)
- Screen reader text: `.sr-only` class (defined in `styles.css` line 188)
- Keyboard navigation: ESC closes modals, Enter/Space activates cards

### Image Optimization
- **WebP format** for all product images (except PNG logos)
- `loading="lazy"` on all images below fold
- Carousel images use `object-fit: cover` with `cursor: pointer` for modal trigger

### State Management
- Carousel state: `current` index variable (line 346)
- Modal open state: `.open` class toggle + `aria-hidden` attribute
- Contact form: `.collapsed` class controls visibility with CSS transitions (line 340-360 in `styles.css`)

### WhatsApp Integration
- Footer social link + modal integration (updates href dynamically, line 64-68 in `script.js`)
- URL format: `https://wa.me/56984131147?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`

## Do NOT...
- Add build tools (Webpack, Vite, etc.) - site must remain static
- Change language to English - all content is in Spanish
- Remove Google Analytics tracking codes (lines 10-60 in `index.html`)
- Use JavaScript frameworks - vanilla JS only
- Change email service without updating credentials and testing

## Common Tasks

### Update Prices
Search for `class="price"` in `index.html` and update values. Keep format: `Por mayor: $X.XXX`

### Add Carousel Slide
1. Add `<figure>` in `.carousel-track` (after line 581)
2. Add corresponding indicator `<button>` (after line 587)
3. Update `total` count is auto-calculated

### Modify Contact Categories
Edit `<select id="contact-category">` options (lines 832-839)

### Change Colors
Primary green: Search/replace `#2c6f4b`
Accent coral: Search/replace `#ff7a59`
All colors defined in embedded CSS (lines 69-549) AND `styles.css`

## Deployment
- **Automatic**: Push to `main` branch triggers GitHub Actions workflow
- **Workflow**: `.github/workflows/pages.yml` - uploads entire repo to Pages
- **Domain**: `rakidistribuidora.cl` (configured via CNAME file)
- **No build step** - files served as-is from repository root

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Test carousel auto-play and touch gestures on mobile
- [ ] Verify contact form EmailJS submission (check spam folder)
- [ ] Check modal open/close with keyboard (ESC key)
- [ ] Validate analytics events fire (use browser console + GA debugger)
- [ ] Test responsive design at all breakpoints
- [ ] Verify images load with lazy loading
- [ ] Check WhatsApp link opens with correct message
